title: Quince Therapeutics Announces Clinically Meaningful Improvements Across Functional, Hemodynamic and Biomarker Measures in Phase 2 Study in PAH and PH-ILD
summary: Data from Phase 2a study of LAM-001 on top of standard of care in PH-ILD patients with refractory PH demonstrated clinically meaningful improvement in multiple assessments of lung function, including improvement in 6MWD of 67.4 meters and PVR reduction of 33.9% at 24 weeks Phase 2b trial in PH-ILD
